mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2D6, CYP3A4) which metabolize primaquine, potentially increasing primaquine levels and risk of hematotoxicity; both drugs also carry independent hematologic risks.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia, methemoglobinemia, and hematologic toxicity; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; baseline and periodic CBC monitoring recommended if combination necessary.
